I'm not a very technical person and don't really understand what this is. I'm curious though since I have a 3DS. What is this exactly and why should I care about it.

It's basically a means of using a MicroSD card to load 3DS games and play them on your 3DS (has both legal, and illegal means, you could technically get free games, but you could also load all of your legally owned games that you own onto one cart and never have to switch out.)

You can make homebrew too, but I think a lot of people use it to get free games. I have one to change my Japanese N3DS special Monster Hunter edition to an American version. It's pretty cool, you can go to http://gbatemp.net/forums/3ds-flashcards-custom-firmwares.201/ to read up on it.
